findings_and_connected_existing.detail: Both explicitly inspected loop versions initialize final_tick to maximum_ticks, use exclusive 0..maximum_ticks and on an exhausted loop report final_tick + 1 as simulated_ticks and convert it into TacticalElapsed. At current 30 Hz and 180 seconds this is 5401 versus 5400 update calls; the separately inspected P16 64 Hz loop analogously gives 11521 versus 11520. Early terminating index k correctly reports k+1. Neither an actual supported timeout nor Bevy schedule execution was established.
